sloka: चिरस्य बत पश्यामि दूराद्भरतमागतम् ।दुष्प्रतीकमरण्ये ऽस्मिन् किं तात वनमागत: ॥ २.१००.५॥
transliteration: cirasya bata paśyāmi dūrādbharatamāgatam ।duṣpratīkamaraṇye 'smin kiṁ tāta vanamāgata: ॥ 2.100.5॥

translations.english: You have come a long distance (from Ayodhya) to this forest, O Bharata It is a pity, dear brother, to see you after a long time, so emaciated. What brings you to the forest?
